sentence_stem: I can't see the board from here, so
correct_completion: I sit at the front of the class.
full_sentence: I can't see the board from here, so I sit at the front of the class.
acceptable_variants: I move closer to the board.
I ask my friend to read it to me.

options.text: I can see every word clearly.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts 'can't see', so it cannot be the logical result of the stem.

options.text: I like the color of the board.
options.why_wrong: This is a true detail, but it does not describe what happens because of the inability to see.
This describes the board but does not give the result of not being able to see it.

options.text: I sit at the front of the class.

grammar_focus: Can / can't for ability, with 'so' introducing a result
explanation: 'Can't' states a lack of ability, so the clause after 'so' must describe the action taken as a result. Turkish speakers may add an extra negative after can't, so keep the negation only once in the verb phrase.
translation: Buradan tahtayı göremiyorum, bu yüzden sınıfın en önünde oturuyorum.
